context.transcript:
Hi Adisa, it's Rebecca Kwan.
I'm calling because we've just completed development of a new fragrance line for JM Sense Incorporated.
And now I need models of the bottles they'll be packaged in.
Could you make 3D prints of the perfume bottles based on my digital renderings?
The problem is that we have a very tight timeline.
The client review is at the end of the week, so the bottles need to be ready by the day the clients start their review.
I'll be happy to pay extra if you can make this project a priority.
context.transcript_translation:
嗨，Adisa，我是Rebecca Kwan。
我打电话来是因为我们刚刚完成了为JM Sense Incorporated开发的新香水系列。
现在我需要它们将要包装的瓶子的模型。
你能根据我的数字渲染图制作香水瓶的3D打印件吗？
问题是我们的时间非常紧张。
客户评审在周末，所以这些瓶子必须在客户开始评审的那天准备好。
如果能把这个项目作为优先事项来处理，我很高兴支付额外的费用。
